description: This file defines a Java class `UndoChargeOffLoanCommandHandler` that handles the 'UNDOCHARGEOFF' command for loans within the Apache Fineract platform. It implements command processing logic to invoke the `undoChargeOff` method on the `LoanWritePlatformService` when processing commands to undo charge-offs on loans.

classes.name: UndoChargeOffLoanCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class that processes 'UNDOCHARGEOFF' commands for loans, delegating to the LoanWritePlatformService to undo a charge-off.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to undo a charge-off by invoking the corresponding method on the LoanWritePlatformService.
